name: perl-proc-fork
description: "This tool provides a block-based interface for the Perl Proc::Fork module to simplify process forking and parallel execution. Use when user asks to fork processes in Perl, manage parent and child process behaviors, or implement retry logic for system forks."
overview: The `perl-proc-fork` skill facilitates the use of the `Proc::Fork` Perl module, which provides an intuitive, block-based interface to the system `fork()` call. Instead of manually managing process IDs and conditional logic, this tool allows you to define specific behaviors for child and parent processes within a unified `run_fork` block. It is ideal for creating daemons, network servers, or any Perl script requiring parallel execution with robust error handling and retry logic.
